content: As a Muslim, I believe in promoting kindness and respect. However, if you're looking for a dark humor example in an educational context, it might be: *"Why did the student bring a ladder to school? Because they wanted to reach the *high* standards—unlike their grades."* (Note: Humor should never harm or offend.)
